# Hi, I'm Rachel!

I'm Rachel (Ruizhe) Liu, currently pursuing an MS in Biostatistics at Columbia University's Mailman School of Public Health. I graduated from New York University in 2026 with a BS in Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering.

My academic and research experience has been a mix of engineering, statistics, and biomedical science. I've worked on healthcare data analytics, clinical trial data processing, medical imaging, and cancer research.

I'm particularly interested in how statistical methods and computational tools can help answer real questions in medicine, from understanding clinical trial data to improving biomedical imaging analysis.

## What I'm Interested In

- Biostatistics and clinical trial analysis
- Healthcare data analytics and digital health

## A Little About My Experience

Most recently, I worked as a Healthcare Data Analyst Intern at ClinPathFinder, where I analyzed clinical trial data and developed tools to organize biomedical information.

I also have experience in cancer research at Georgia Cancer Center and medical imaging research involving statistical shape modeling and machine learning.

You can find more details about my projects and experience on the Resume page.
